(5)rnam dpyod dgas pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/(6)sangs rgyas kun sa bka' drin can/bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/rang sems gyong po 'dul ba la/gsal

tei:div.tei:p: (5)rnam dpyod dgas pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (6)sangs rgyas kun sa bka' drin can/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ rang sems gyong po 'dul ba la/ gsal 'debs phan pa'i skyes cig zhu/ thog ma med nas goms pa'i shugs/ bag chags long shor shog dril bzhin/ nyon mongs dug ro ci skyes yang*/ de dbang ma btang gnyen po brten/ dug lnga rang gar yan shor nas/ yengs med sgom med kha pho 'di/ skye 'chi'i 'gags la gtug pa'i tshe/ tha mal bas kyang zhan du 'chi/ stong lta skam po'i mtho skad 'di/ deng seng dus na lhag par mang*/ tshul 'chos lta stangs gcer ba dang*/ smra yang mdo don gtor ba mang*/ bstod smad tshig gi legs nyes kyis/ sems la dga' sdug rgyun mi chad/ da dung dge bas phan mi gdags/ sdig pas mi gnod bdud tshig 'di/ bsgom chen rnams kyi nang na snang*/ de ni mu stegs lta ba dang*/ khyad par (7)dbye ba yod ma yin/ rgyang chad lta bar rdzogs chen gyi/ ming gi khyad par tsam du zad/ rgya nag mkhan po'i lta ba bzhin/ dge rtog sdig rtog gnyis po yang*/ 'ching ba'i sgo nas khyad par med/ gang yang yid la mi byed zer/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i lam/ ngan par blta zhing rtsis med 'dor/ dge ba btang bas mi dge'i sgrub/ blang dor phyin ci log lam zhugs/ lam log rang mgo 'khor dus 'dir/ yang dag lam ston bshes gnyen brten/ rgyu 'bras gnas la yid ches dgos/ las dang de'i 'bras bu la/ nam yang bslu ba med pa'i phyir/ sdig pa'i rnam smin sdug bsngal ba/ mi 'dod na yang nges par 'byung*/ stong nyid rten 'byung shar ba dang*/ rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa'i gnas/ shin tu gnad gal che na yang*/ rten 'brel rtogs pa srid mtha' tsam/ mtshan bcas mtshan ma med pa zhes/ shing bu dang ni (8)rde'u la/ sems 'jin mdung tshugs gtad po can/ de la thar lam rnal ma med/ zhi gnas sgrub pa'i thabs yin zhes/ da dung nyes bshad mang po mthong*/

mi tshe stong zad mod med kyi/ bdud kyi gsang tshig mang po spel/ skye 'gags gsum la grangs btab zhing*/ rtog la rtog mthud 'khrul ba'i sems/ gnas 'gyu rig pa'i sgros bzang po/ rang dgar 'khrul rtog zang mar zad/ btang snyoms lung ma bstan du 'byams/ rtog med sems la sku gsum gyi/ ngo sprod mun pa'i mda' 'phen bzhin/ gnad med stong zob a re 'khrul/ lnga bdo'i snyigs ma'i dus 'di na/ long bas long ba khrid pa bzhin/ phyin rtsi log gi g.yang pa la/ rang gzhan gnyis ka skyur ba mang*/ cang med had por lta ba 'di/ mu stegs byed dang khyad par med/ rnam dpyod rig pa'i dmigs bu la/ brten nas lam gshad shes pa dgos/ (9)lung dang rig pa'i skya bar nas/ rgyud la zhus dag thon pa dgos/ med na yod rlom pho tshod 'di/ rang mgo bskor ba'i sgyu ma yin/ gsal rig sems la ye shes dang*/ snang stong zung 'jug yin zhes pa/ gong mar drangs ba'i thabs tsam las/ nges don nyid du 'jin pa nor/ gsal rig sems kyi 'jin stangs la/ mdung tshugs dran pa brten pa 'di/ skyes bu bdag tu lta ba dang*/ khyad par cung zad yod ma yin/ mu stegs byed po 'ga' zhig gis/ bdag rtag chen po dgu ldan dang*/ shes rig yul dang bral ba las/ thar bar 'dod pa nyid dang mtshungs/ rtag par lta ba'i bye brag la/ nang gi 'dod pa mtha' yas bzhin/ da dus ming gi brjod tshul gyi/ rdzogs chen ngo sprod 'debs pa mang*/ a cang de la dgag pa ci/ log pa'i lam ni grangs (10)mang bas/ blun po spyi brtol nyid yin na/ rmongs pas bran du byas par zad/ mang du thos pa 'ga' zhig gis/ rgyu 'bras blang dor log par song*/ tshul khrims gtong zhing sbyin pa bsrung*/ bslab pa mi len mjes ma len/ dgag bya ma nges sgrub bya tshol/ rtags chos ma nges thal 'gyur 'phen/ rtag log khyab log lta snang gis/ rang lugs yin 'dod a thang chad/ spros bral khas len med pa de/

gar 'gro ma shes lung tsam la/ skyabs su re nas mkhas pa'i khur/ len pa 'di ni bzhad gad gnas/ rnal ma'i zol gyis gzi byin sgrub/ tshul 'chos 'dul ba yin par re/ ngan sems g.yo rgyus gos bzang gis/ gzhan mgo bskor la su bas mkhas/ tshong dang bun skyed pho zo 'don/ nor dang longs spyod phan tshun 'gran/ phrag dog gdug rtsub spyod ngan gyis/ thams cad sems sun 'byin pa las/ pho rgod bzang po'i go pa snyogs/ rang skyon mi mthong gzhan mtshang gyer/ (11)bla ma mched la zhe 'gras sgrub/ rang nyid ngan song gnas su skyur/ gna' dus bzang po'i srol bzang nub/ da dus ngan pa'i zla ba shar/ phar la bslab kyang tshur la 'thab/ bzang lan ngan gyi mjal ba byung*/ mchod 'os mi bkur gdug 'dre brten/ tshogs bsags mi brtson las ngan gsog pha ma rgan rabs yid sun 'byin/ bla ma mkhan slob rgyab tu dor/ kye ma dus ngan snyigs ma 'dir/ rang mgo chos kyis ma bton na/ 'chi ba glo bur sleb tsa na/ pha ma gnyen bshes longs spyod kyis/ phan dang skyob pa ci yang med/ dal 'byor mi lus rin po che/ dge bas snying po ci len gyis/ lus ngag dge sbyor phra mo nas/ ci 'grub 'bungs gsum chos la thon/ dal khoms re 'gas mi 'ong gi 'chi bdag bdud ni nyin bzhin 'ong*/ thabs gzhan gang gis bzlog med par/ myur du 'chi bdag lag tu 'gro bsnon med 'brid pa dang bcas pa/ ri (12)gzar rgod por sbab 'dril bzhin/ chu phran rgya mtshor nyogs pa bzhin/ mi tshe lo zla zhag za mas/ skad cig re bzhin zad par 'gyur/ gson pa'i yun ni thung ngu 'dir/ rnam g.yeng don med gyi nar 'khyams/ dam chos bya ba'i long skabs bral/ spyir na tshe la nges pa med/ gson pa'i rkyen ni nyung zad tsam/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni chos mang bas/ glo bur tshe la su yid rten/ 'chi tshe gnyen dang bshed dang dang*/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyis/ phan med dkar nag dge sdig gnyis/

grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*/ dge ba dang ni sdig pa'i chos/ ma thob par yang mi shes na/ thos mang sdig la spyod pa na/ shin tu ngo tsha'i gnas su ltos/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa la/ snying nas yid ches skye ba ni/ 'phags chos yon tan kun gyi rten/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bstod/ bden bzhi'i lam la blang dor gyis/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gnas/ (13)dran pa shes bzhin bag yod par/ nam ya rang gi rgyu dang 'grogs/ ston dang bstan pa bslab don gyi/ dkon mchog rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ yid ches gting nas khel ba yis/ blo ce skyabs 'gros tshog pa dgos/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i chos/ ji snyed gcig las mchog gyur pa/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ med thabs med pas goms 'dris kyis/ bskyed rdzogs mthon po'i kha skad 'di/ rgya mtsho'i pha mtha'i nor bzhin du/ ji bzhin nyams su myong ba dka'/ de bas blo sna nang du khug rang gi rgyud tshod bstun bzhin tu/ sngon 'gro'i chos gzhung ma shor bar/ rnam dag lam la thos pa dang*/ bsam pa gnad du 'gro bar gyis/ blo skyed rim gyis ma bton na/ 'phags lam cig char 'gro ba dkon/ chos la yar skyed bton (14)pa bzhin/ blo la bong skyed yod pa dgos/ rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skad kyis/ rnyigs dus skye bo phal mo che/ rlom sems rlung gis khyer ba mang*/ ha cang bzang po ma snga bar/ thog med goms pa'i nyon mongs pa'i/ log rtog cig char mi spong gi gnyen po rim gyis brten pa dgos/ mang thos tshig gi zhe kheng zhing*/ nyon mongs rgyas pa thul dka' bas/ bsam sgom 'bad pa drag po yi/ nges shes gnyen po'i mdung thung brten/ dngos po'i gshis la ma grub kyang*/ rmi lam nang gi rgyu 'bras bzhin/ 'khrul ngo'i rgyu 'bras mi bslu bas/ sdig spang dge ba ci 'grub dgos/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kun/ las dang nyon mongs rgyu las byung*/

rtsa ba bdag tu 'jin las byung*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i nges shes bskyed/ gzung 'jin gnyis med rang byung gi ye shes gdod nas ma skyes (15)(16)pa/ bla 'das smra bsam brjod med la/ myong ba rgyud la thon par gyis/ dang po'i las can rtogs pa la/ gsal chad yod de gnas cha med/ rtog pa'i rlung la ma skur bar/ rgyud la dran shes bag yod brten/ mdor na dus gsum dge ba rnams/ byang chub sems dang bsngo smon gyis/ dam pa gsum dang 'brel ba na/ bla med sangs rgyas thob par nges/ lo 'dod chos brgyad slob gnyer dang ltar snang bcos ma'i bsgom pa gnyis/ byas yus 'dren pa'i bya btang gsum/ rang mgo bskor ba'i zog po yin/ de 'dra'i ltar snang chos gzugs la/ dpe 'dren ma byed rang sems 'di/ dam pa chos kyis zhus dag gyis/
ces pa'ang 'jang 'gyur med rdo rje'i ngor chos smra ba tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa dge'o//
